title: THE AI 3D WORLD FROM SINGLE IMAGE IS AVAILABLE NOW
description:
You can now turn a single image into a full 3D world you can walk through and explore no modeling software no game engine no plugins This is Worlds by OpenArt Heres how it works o Upload or generate an image OpenArt turns it into a navigable 3D world o Explore the world and frame a shot from any angle o Place your own characters or objects inside the world o Capture highfidelity screenshots directly from the world o Use those screenshots as keyframes to generate polished video clips The key breakthrough here is scene consistency Instead of prompting a scene over and over hoping all of the details stay the same you now have a consistent set to direct shots within Powered by World Labs spatial AI the final capture can also be exported as 3D meshes for use in professional software like Unreal Engine OpenArtPartner
Roberto Nickson
